commit.message:
fix(ci): retain declared diagnostics and adopt Memories 3.0.23

Preserve byte-bound redacted lifecycle, native and functional diagnostics after receipt-owned cleanup. Bind the published Memories declaration without extending Platform admission.

fix(ci): publish complete diagnostics atomically

Preserve the owning four MiB fixed metadata bound. Flush complete private diagnostic bytes before atomic publication and preserve immutable destinations and identical retries.

build(audit): record the published Memories 3.0.23 selection

Refresh only the Memories family through the normal audit generator and preserve the other 155 family decisions and all prior provenance.

fix(ci): keep diagnostic publication retryable after interruption

Use Linux no-replace rename for complete flushed snapshots. Preserve single-link custody and verify actual collector SIGKILL followed by identical retry.

refactor(ci): clarify diagnostic custody checks

Separate complete snapshot writing, exact owner binding and unique reference validation.
Preserve all negative cases and cleanup assertions while resolving required readability and formatting findings.

build(audit): anchor Memories provenance in retained main history

Regenerate only Memories through the normal audit generator using the prior published snapshot.
Bind the observation to accepted main ad54fc75b8a1da663ee39da6a2397fc2a965159c so squash preserves reachable provenance.
Preserve every package selection and the unchanged ancestry validator.

fix(release): verify final branch reference identity

Recheck complete live refs and production executed validation before tags
or package pushes.

Keep local executed qualification offline and preserve recorded CI run
and attempt checks.

test(release): name live source fixture argument

Address shell:S7679 by binding the helper argument locally before jq.

Keep the full-reference fixtures and all 28 release-source cases unchanged.

fix(runtime): retain safe prerequisite launch diagnostics

Carry finite failure kinds and native error codes from helper startup into
HXR015 without retaining exception text or process inputs.

Cover actual missing, permission-denied and held-writer launches and preserve
nonzero exit, timeout, cancellation and bounded output controls.

build: merge current main into diagnostic review

strict required status checks, preserving the reviewed content tree and
original guard commits in the review branch history.

+// <copyright file="CompositionProcessStartFailureKind.cs" company="ITANEO">
+// Copyright (c) ITANEO (https://www.itaneo.com). All rights reserved.
+// Licensed under the MIT license. See LICENSE file in the project root for full license information.
+// </copyright>
+
+namespace Hexalith.Builds.Tooling.Runtime;
+
+/// <summary>Identifies the finite failure classes caught while starting a helper.</summary>
+public enum CompositionProcessStartFailureKind
+{
+    /// <summary>The process start operation returned false.</summary>
+    ReturnedFalse = 0,
+
+    /// <summary>The native process launch failed.</summary>
+    Win32 = 1,
+
+    /// <summary>The process start operation encountered an input/output failure.</summary>
+    InputOutput = 2,
+
+    /// <summary>The process start operation was invalid.</summary>
+    InvalidOperation = 3,
+
+    /// <summary>The platform does not support the process start operation.</summary>
+    PlatformNotSupported = 4,
+}
